import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(a)==len(items)
for r,s in zip(items,a):
 assert r['item_id']==s['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(s['slots'])==expected
 assert set(s['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in s['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in s['confidence'].values())
 assert s['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
 assert isinstance(s['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
c=collections.Counter(v for s in a for v in s['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order and full slot coverage:',len(a),'items')
print('Slot calls:',{k:c[k] for k in ['ъ','ь','other','u']})
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(s['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for s in a))
PY
